items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The transcript identifies Preston Love as the interviewer ('Conducted by Preston Love') and the interviewee addresses him as 'Preston' during the conversation, but no specific professional or personal relationship history between Ernie Fields and Preston Love is described in the text.

ctx.x: First Ernie, I started asking you where you were born, when and how it all began with you.

I was born in Nacogdoches, Texas, Sunday at midnight, August 28, 1904. Reverend Thomas Jefferson Fields was my father and Mary Jane Garrett Fields, mother. The baby of the family of three boys and two girls. The family moved to an all black town, Taft, Oklahoma, 1905. At that time, indian territory.
